project_metadata.title: 三隻小豬的森林冒險
project_metadata.global_style_prompt: Digital storybook illustration, vibrant Pixar style, 3D render feel, rich fairytale mood, soft cinematic lighting, highly detailed environments.

character_master.name: 豬小弟
character_master.body_features: Plump, cute pink skin, short curly tail, expressive snout.

environment.location: A cozy pig house at the edge of the forest.
environment.key_elements: Luggage bags, a wooden fence, blooming flowers.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright and warm morning light, feeling hopeful but slightly cautious.

scenes.narration: 豬爸爸和豬媽媽把行李交給三兄弟。他們叮嚀著：「森林裡有大野狼，你們一定要小心喔！」
scenes.image_prompt: Standing together with parents, receiving small luggage bags, waving goodbye. Wide shot establishing the starting environment.

environment.location: Deep inside a lush green forest.
environment.key_elements: Tall ancient trees, a winding dirt path, scattered leaves.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dappled sunlight filtering through the canopy, creating an adventurous atmosphere.

scenes.narration: 三隻小豬各自背著行囊，踏上了未知的旅程。他們在森林裡走啊走，尋找適合蓋房子的空地。
scenes.image_prompt: Walking along the dirt path side by side, looking around curiously at the tall trees. Medium shot advancing the journey.

environment.location: A wide, flat grassy clearing in the forest.
environment.key_elements: Green grass, a small stream nearby, scattered wild mushrooms.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft afternoon sunlight illuminating the clearing, peaceful and inviting.

scenes.narration: 終於，他們發現了一處平坦又陰涼的空地。豬兄弟們決定在這裡停下來，開始建造屬於自己的新家。
scenes.image_prompt: Pointing excitedly at the open grassy space, dropping their luggage bags with relieved smiles. Wide shot establishing the new location.

environment.location: A spot in the grassy clearing.
environment.key_elements: A massive pile of golden yellow straw.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright sunlight hitting the golden straw, making it glow warmly.

scenes.narration: 貪玩的豬大哥找來最輕的乾草。他隨便把乾草捆一捆、疊一疊，一下子就蓋好了他的新房子。
scenes.image_prompt: Stacking bundles of straw carelessly while yawning, looking lazy and eager to finish quickly. Medium shot showing the building process.

environment.key_elements: A pile of rough wooden logs and branches.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Sun slowly setting, casting slightly longer shadows over the wood.

scenes.narration: 豬二哥覺得累了，於是撿了些木頭當材料。他連釘子都懶得用，隨意把木頭堆疊起來就算完成了。
scenes.image_prompt: Balancing wooden logs on top of each other clumsily, wiping sweat from the forehead. Medium shot focusing on the fragile structure.

environment.location: A solid patch of land in the clearing.
environment.key_elements: A sturdy pile of gray stones, a wooden bucket filled with wet mud.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Golden hour lighting, emphasizing hard work and dedication.

scenes.narration: 只有豬小弟選擇了最堅固的石頭。他仔細地用泥漿把石頭緊緊黏結，決心要蓋一棟擋得住大野狼的房子。
scenes.image_prompt: Carefully applying mud to a stone with a trowel, wearing a determined and focused expression. Close-up shot highlighting the serious attitude.

environment.location: Dark bushes at the edge of the clearing.
environment.key_elements: Thick, shadowy leaves and thorny vines.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dark and mysterious shadows contrasting with the fading daylight, highly tense.

scenes.narration: 這時，一雙銳利的眼睛正從暗處盯著他們。原來是那隻凶惡的大野狼，正盤算著今晚的美味大餐。
scenes.image_prompt: Lurking behind the leaves, showing only glowing eyes and a wicked smirk, staring hungrily towards the clearing. Close-up shot capturing the evil intent.

environment.location: In front of the flimsy straw house.
environment.key_elements: The straw house, a big bad wolf.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cold silver moonlight illuminating the scene, scary and dramatic mood.

scenes.narration: 夜晚降臨，大野狼悄悄來到豬大哥的門前。他深吸一口氣，輕輕一吹，就把乾草屋吹得無影無蹤！
scenes.image_prompt: Taking a massive breath and blowing powerfully at the fragile structure, sending straw flying everywhere. Wide shot capturing the destruction.

environment.location: The path between the straw and wooden houses.
environment.key_elements: Scattered straw flying in the wind, a dirt path.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dark forest background with dim moonlight, conveying panic and urgency.

scenes.narration: 豬大哥嚇得魂飛魄散，拼命逃跑！他一路狂奔，躲進了豬二哥的木頭房子裡，嚇得全身發抖。
scenes.image_prompt: Running frantically with arms flailing in panic, looking back over the shoulder in terror. Medium shot tracking the intense action.

environment.location: In front of the wooden house.
environment.key_elements: The wooden log house, the big bad wolf.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Harsh, dramatic shadows cast by the moonlight, chaotic and terrifying.

scenes.narration: 大野狼立刻追了過來。他這次用力一吹，嘩啦嘩啦！所有的木頭瞬間散落一地，房子又垮了！
scenes.image_prompt: Blowing violently again, causing the logs to collapse and scatter across the ground. Wide shot showing the chaotic impact.

environment.key_elements: Solid stone walls, a roaring fireplace, a heavy wooden door.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm, safe orange glow from the fireplace contrasting with the cold night outside.

scenes.narration: 兩兄弟拔腿就跑，躲進豬小弟的石頭屋緊緊抱在一起。豬小弟拍拍胸脯說：「別怕，我的房子很堅固！」
scenes.image_prompt: Trembling and hugging each other tightly, while standing protectively in front with a confident smile. Medium shot emphasizing the emotional contrast.

environment.key_elements: Solid stone walls with mud joints, the big bad wolf.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cold moonlight highlighting the solid texture of the stones.

scenes.narration: 大野狼來到石頭屋前，用盡全力一直吹。他吹到臉紅脖子粗，但這棟堅固的房子卻連晃都沒晃一下。
scenes.image_prompt: Puffing cheeks out to the maximum, face turning red with extreme effort, looking frustrated at the unmoving wall. Close-up shot focusing on the furious expression.

environment.location: The roof of the brick house.
environment.key_elements: A stone chimney, roof tiles, the full moon in the background.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Silhouetted against the bright moon, sneaky and suspenseful atmosphere.

scenes.narration: 又氣又餓的大野狼心生一計。他看見屋頂上的煙囪，得意地笑了笑，決定從那裡溜進屋裡吃掉小豬。
scenes.image_prompt: Sneaking carefully onto the roof, looking down into the chimney with a wicked, triumphant grin. Wide shot establishing the new threat from above.

environment.location: Inside the brick house, beneath the chimney.
environment.key_elements: A large iron cauldron, boiling water, a roaring fire.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Intense heat and bright orange firelight illuminating the room from below.

scenes.narration: 聰明冷靜的豬小弟早就料到這招了！他趕緊在火爐上放了一大鍋水，並把水煮得熱滾滾的。
scenes.image_prompt: Stirring a bubbling black cauldron over a roaring fire, looking upwards with a sharp, prepared gaze. Medium shot focusing on the defensive action.

environment.key_elements: The iron cauldron, water splashing out.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright, joyful, and triumphant lighting from the fireplace.

scenes.narration: 咻！大野狼順著煙囪滑下來，撲通一聲掉進熱水裡燙死了。三隻小豬歡呼慶祝，終於可以安心睡覺了！
scenes.image_prompt: Falling straight down into the pot with a shocked expression, while jumping around cheering with raised arms. Wide shot capturing the victorious finale.
